cohort: The study cohort comprised 445 patients who underwent third-trimester amniocentesis (TTA).
finding: The administration of glucocorticoids prior to third-trimester amniocentesis (TTA) did not significantly reduce the rates of neonatal complications.
gest_age: Deliveries ranged from 28 to over 37 weeks, including 2.7% between 28-34 weeks, 9% between 34-37 weeks, and term deliveries.
